correctness.rationale: Soc R=m² is one-dimensional over F_q; multiplication induces nondegenerate symmetric B on m/m². Each projective line has q(q−1) nonzero lift vertices; perpendicularity is an involution on P¹: isotropic fixed lines give full cliques, nonisotropic two-cycles give K_(s,s); socle nonzero vertices form universal K_(q−1). Binary symmetric form types yield t=0 or 2 (odd characteristic), t=1 or q+1 (even). The graph decomposition gives exact degree, edge, clique/chromatic, chromatic polynomial, automorphism-wreath and equitable-block spectral formulas. Representative direct multiplication graphs for q2 and q3, both types, independently matched predicted degrees, edges and t; prior package script contains additional finite checks. These checks are not proof for all finite fields. Mixed-characteristic ring (Z/p²)[t]/t² indeed has the split B and different characteristic from F_p[x,y]/(x²,y²).

originality.rationale: Kadu 2021 Proposition 3.6 ALREADY proves the exact bilinear orthogonality/Gorenstein equivalence; no originality of this key premise. His published work focuses compressed clique numbers and does not derive this full ordinary graph type or its chromatic, automorphism, and spectral formulas. The published same-date Witt-type theorem is dimension >=3 (not 2), while degree-sequence rigidity treats split equicharacteristic rings and the degree statistic, not the full ordinary graph or mixed-characteristic examples. The present complete graph classification is a useful consequence of known orthogonality plus additional projective-line combinatorics, with a residual risk of older implicit polarity graph classification.
residual_risks: Core bilinear criterion is decisively known from Kadu 2021; only graph-theoretic refinement is considered for originality.
Original Kadu–Tanpure 2026 full paper not accessible; accessible abstract did not show the same graph classification, not sufficient for whole-document NOT_COVERING.
Potential earlier textbook polarity graph blow-up theorem may provide the same structural decomposition implicitly.

value.rationale: Natural full graph-isomorphism classification of short rank-two Gorenstein rings, exact whole-family colorings, automorphism groups and adjacency spectra, plus a precise information-loss example across ring characteristics. The value is the structural classification and applications, not the known multiplication lemma; elementary derivability alone is not textbook repetition.

final_claim: For finite local Gorenstein R with m³=0 ≠m² and dim_k m/m²=2, ordinary zero divisor graph is K_(q−1) joined to t cliques K_(q(q−1)) and (q+1−t)/2 complete bicliques of same part size, with exact invariants and mixed-characteristic non-reconstruction.
limitations: Finite commutative Artinian local Gorenstein, Hilbert (1,2,1) only; graph not ring automorphism group; no general emb dim >=3 theorem.
